environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS passthrough. No API gateway or request validation layer. The application is directly exposed to client traffic on port 443. gRPC downstream service (user-service) trusts metadata headers for authorization decisions, specifically the 'authorization' and 'authenticated-user' metadata keys.

config.grpc_service_auth: metadata-based trust (no mTLS verification of caller identity)
config.network: public-facing NLB -> ECS tasks on port 3000
